resources.string: Remove two uncovered cards that add up to 13: Queen and Ace, Jack and 2, 10 and 3… A King goes on its own. Tap the deck to turn a new card. Clear the whole pyramid to win.
This card is worth %1$d: tap a card worth %2$d.

No more cards can be removed. You can undo some moves and try another way, or give up.
